# Minimap

> Parody ARPG played entirely on the minimap: procedural biome dungeons, click-to-move pathfinding, rarity dots, boss telegraphs, and an atlas grind from level 80 to 100

- Live: https://minimap.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: game, arpg, parody, procedural, pathfinding, static-site
